faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Clerical Staff post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Clerical Staff position at Graphic Era University is 01 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Clerical Staff position at the Deep Tech Innovation Centre of Graphic Era University as per the current recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly through email. Interested candidates must send their detailed CV and relevant documents to the official email address provided by the university for the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate in any field. Additionally, they are required to have at least 2 years of experience in the field and possess basic computer knowledge including MS Word and Excel.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Clerical Staff recruitment at Graphic Era University. Candidates can apply for the position free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Clerical Staff position consists of two main stages: a thorough screening of the submitted CVs followed by a personal interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The university has stated that an extremely lucrative salary will be offered to exceptional candidates who have a proven track record in the relevant field of clerical and administrative work.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for the Clerical Staff position is Dehradun, Uttarakhand, where the Graphic Era University campus is situated. The role is specifically for the Deep Tech Innovation Centre.

faq.question: Q9. What skills are required for this role?
faq.answer: Apart from being a graduate, candidates need proficiency in MS Word, Excel, drafting professional emails, and maintaining effective file management and record-keeping systems to handle daily administrative tasks efficiently.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply if I do not have 2 years of experience?
faq.answer: The notification specifies a requirement of 2 years of experience in the field. It is highly recommended that candidates meet this criteria to be considered eligible for the selection process.
